# GNote++

> GNote++ is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) text and code editor for macOS, built on the source code of Notepad++. It is a native SwiftUI app using the Scintilla editing engine, for Macs with Apple silicon running macOS 13 or later. Current version: 1.3.0 (2026-10-06).

GNote++ is the closest thing to "Notepad++ for Mac": Notepad++ itself only runs on Windows, and GNote++ reuses its language definitions, color themes, encoding detection and editing engine without Wine or emulation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Notepad++.

## Features

- Syntax highlighting for every Notepad++ language, light and dark themes
- Tabs, file tree, session restore, reload of files changed on disk
- Find and replace with regular expressions; find in files across a folder
- Markdown editor with live GitHub Flavored Markdown preview (tables, task lists, alerts), outline, table formatting, image paste, print and PDF export
- Mermaid diagrams in the Markdown preview, exportable as PNG or SVG
- Bookmarks, code folding, change history, brace and tag matching, smart highlight, multi-cursor and column editing, autocompletion, function list, minimap
- Encoding and line-ending detection preserved on save
- Per-document edit lock (read-only), spell checker in English and Spanish
- Interface in English and Spanish
